title: Har Daur Me Hussain ka Matam
body:
Har daur me Husain ka matam karege hum
Koi kare kare na kare hum karege hum
1 Ho gar koi yazid hame aake rok le x2
Zikre shahide Karbobala hum karege hum
2 Jis khak par Husain ne sarko kata diya x2
Kaaba samaj ke us pe jabin khum karege hum
3 Rokar kaha Sakina ne Ammu kidhar chale x2
Shikwa bhi tumse pyaas ka ab kum Karege hum
4 Laasho pe shahido ke ye Zainab ke bain the x2
Royege tum to aakh ko purnam karege hum
5 Maqsad hai zindagi ka Munawwar to hai yahi x2
Charcha gamey Husain ka har dam karege hum
